info.title: QuickER.Cli
info.description: The QuickER CLI as a dotnet tool: C# code generation from an ER diagram JSON (generate), database-direct diagram scaffolding (scaffold), C# reverse import (reverse), and a stdio MCP server for AI agents (mcp). QuickER is an ER diagram designer that turns a single reviewed model into DDL, C# data access, and documentation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: QuickER - a CLI that generates C# code from an ER diagram or database

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate C# code from an ER diagram JSON

options.name: --schema
options.description: Input ER diagram JSON file (the app's save format)

options.name: --out
options.description: Output folder for the generated code

options.name: --config
options.description: Generation option settings file (quicker.json)

options.name: --provider
options.description: Target database type (default: sqlserver) [default: sqlserver]

options.name: --domain-layer-dir
options.description: Domain layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Domain; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --presentation-layer-dir
options.description: Presentation layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Presentation; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --infrastructure-layer-dir
options.description: Infrastructure layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Infrastructure; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --server-layer-dir
options.description: Server layer folder for layered output, relative to --out; only used with remote services (default: Server; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --code-subdir
options.description: Output subfolder for the generated code, one level below the layer folder (or below --out without layered output); blank = no subfolder; never affects namespaces (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --root-namespace
options.description: Root namespace of the generated code (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --runtime-namespace
options.description: Namespace for the shared runtime (fixed code) when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --entity-namespace
options.description: Namespace for Entity classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --edit-model-namespace
options.description: Namespace for EditModel classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --mapper-namespace
options.description: Namespace for Mapper classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --repository-namespace
options.description: Namespace for Repository classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --value-object-namespace
options.description: Namespace for value object classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --api-docs-subdir
options.description: Output subfolder for the API reference Markdown, relative to the output directory (e.g. docs; blank = the output directory itself; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --api-docs-file
options.description: File name for the API reference Markdown (the extension is normalized to .g.md; the Japanese version reuses the base name; blank = derived from the output file name, or ApiDocs.g.md when files are split; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Output file name for single-file output; only the file name part is used and the output directory is always --out (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --split-files-by-category
options.description: Output each category in a separate file and namespace (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --layered-output
options.description: Split generated files into per-layer subfolders (Domain / Presentation / Infrastructure / Server); implies --split-files-by-category (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-edit-models
options.description: Generate EditModel classes (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-mappers
options.description: Generate Mapper classes (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-value-objects
options.description: Generate a value object type per column (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --use-guid-key-for-string-primary-key
options.description: Turn string primary keys into GuidKey value objects (only when value objects are generated; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-repositories
options.description: Generate QuickER Repositories (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --exclude-unbounded-binary-columns
options.description: Exclude unbounded binary columns (varbinary(max), BLOB without a length) from the generated Repository's SELECT/UPDATE; INSERT keeps all columns (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-ef-core-repositories
options.description: Generate EF Core code (QuickErDbContext and EF Core Repositories) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-in-memory-repositories
options.description: Generate in-memory Repository implementations for testing (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-sync-support
options.description: Generate the bidirectional sync support for a server (SQL Server) plus local (SQLite) setup (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-remote-contracts
options.description: Additionally generate remote-capable Repository interfaces I{Entity}RemoteRepository (CRUD, save, named queries only; I{Entity}Repository keeps all methods and inherits it) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-remote-services
options.description: Include the HTTP client implementation of the remote surface in the main output, and additionally output an ASP.NET Core server implementation to {baseName}.RemoteServer.g.cs (implies the remote surface --generate-remote-contracts automatically; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --use-runtime-packages
options.description: Do not include the runtime (fixed code) in the generated code; rely on references to the NuGet packages QuickER.Runtime.* instead (can be combined with EF Core generation; overrides the settings file)

options.name: --generate-api-docs
options.description: Additionally output one API reference Markdown ({baseName}.g.md) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --api-docs-ja
options.description: Also output the Japanese API reference Markdown ({base}.ja.g.md; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --include-data-annotations
options.description: Add DataAnnotations and DB-definition meta attributes ([Required], [MaxLength], [DbTableMeta], etc.) (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --include-json-ignore-on-parent-navigation
options.description: Add [JsonIgnore] to parent-reference navigations (overrides the settings file)

options.name: --repository-dialects
options.description: Dialects for which to also generate QuickER Repositories (comma-separated, multiple allowed; e.g. sqlserver,sqlite). When omitted, a single dialect is derived from --provider. Overrides the settings file.

commands.name: reverse
commands.description: Reverse a C# file generated with IncludeDataAnnotations ON into a schema-only ER diagram JSON

options.name: --source
options.description: Input C# source file (a main .g.cs generated with IncludeDataAnnotations ON)

options.name: --out
options.description: Output ER diagram JSON file (schema only; no layout key)

options.name: --provider
options.description: Target database type (default: sqlserver) [default: sqlserver]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Start a stdio MCP server that exposes ER diagram editing and code generation tools for AI agents (communicates over stdin/stdout using JSON-RPC; each tool takes the target diagram file as its 'file' argument)
